Question B-005-001-004. Lesson link: L-005-01.

Why the correct answer is right: One microfarad equals 1 000 000 picofarads, so the value is 1 microfarad.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: This is ten times too large.
- sourceIndex 2: This is one hundred times too small.
- sourceIndex 3: This is one thousand times too small.
